card.name: Digits inside numbers after a comma
card.fires_on: A digit or decimal point partway through a number, mostly the hundreds digit after a thousands comma (1,<<2>>00 mg) or the point in a percentage like 21.8.

modes.label: Thousands-comma digit
modes.description: The first digit after the comma in a four-digit dose such as 1,200 or 1,400.

modes.label: Decimal in a percentage
modes.description: The decimal point or digit inside a table or study percentage.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of written numbers, like the 2 in 1,200 mg or the point in 21.8%.
